notes.title: Monthly Update.
notes.notes:
It has been several months since my last monthly update,  I have been working away on warlocks 4 and am quite happy with how it is progressing,  There is however allot more work to do before I start releasing copies to beta testers.  I have a list of people who have requested beta access but anyone else wishing to participate should make them selves know and I will add them to the list.
The more testers the better.

notes.title: Monthly update August 2024.
notes.notes:
Short update.

GalaxIverse II launch went well, no bug reports and good reviews.

Warlocks 4 toolchain is still under development, I am currently battling with importing model and animation data  ( using assimp library ).
Unlike previous warlocks games that loaded all the assets at the start of the game, Warlocks 4 will use a caching and discard method to only have assets that are currently needed,  This allows me to have much more content at higher resolutions and also speeds up the initial loading.

notes.title: 11 August 2024 - bugfix.
notes.notes: This is sub version ZZ an attempt to fix a users bug.  Increase the verts count supported by a single game column.

notes.title: Monthly update.
notes.notes:
I plan to provide general monthly updates based around all my different games and how they are to be developed.  

Keep Up to date with new games and updates by joining my community group.

Galaxiverse II is launching 1st August and is free to play,  add to your Wishlist.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2750980/GalaxIverse_II/

Warlocks 4 ( unnamed ) is in planning stage and I am currently building the toolchain that I plan to use.

Core objectives

AI to switch from a path generation system to a flow field system.  I think this will be much more fluid and less processor intensive.

Dynamic model loading, At present I load all models when the game loads, I will switch this to only load on demand.  This allows me to have far more items with higher resolution whilst speeding up loading and reducing the memory footprint.  This primarily applies to Hud/holding based items.

At present the engine supports 9 worlds of 16384x16384 voxels.  I'm going to half the map size but support far more worlds, Maybe even Fairspace size. ( I would like to mash Fairspace/warlocks together ).

Dedicated server to support 32 or maybe 64 players.

Tricks and traps in the constructions / Points of interest.

The game will be released as early access and will probably stay like that for a few years.

notes.title: Update 22nd June 2024
notes.notes:
The game now supports alt+enter switching between window mode and full screen, I don't consider the game playable in window mode unless the mouse is bound to the window, so I have added a key bind F4 that switches between mouse locked and unlocked.

Fix to animprops transitions smoother, Probably nothing noticeable.

Fix issue with ambient occlusion.

Created additional gbuffer options for 1.5x and 2.0x  this will render the game into larger buffers and then down sample for improved visual fidelity. This is more GPU intensive so please don't use unless you have a really good GPU.

Removed the Get request for Steel shovel for the farmer and replaced with another egg one.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2479780/discussions/0/4338733821686566709/

As mentioned in this forum post, I am considering drawing a line under "Warlocks Deeds" and starting another warlocks game with a different adventure "Warlocks *unnamed*".  Allot of my planned mechanics and updates are different and I would rather have a title under early access to do such changes.
I'm going to work on my editor and bone animation system for a bit so wont decide this right now.

Anyone wishing to participate in early pre-release testing, Please just post here with, "test" and I will add you in when the time comes.

Also for those interested, I have another game launching soon, Please add to your Wishlist if its your kind of game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2750980/GalaxIverse_II/

notes.notes:
I have added several more icon storage crates, these are available to build on the workbench rather on yourself, I didn't want to clutter the list up too much.

I may in a few days, remove all of them and instead give the user the option of changing the loot container looks in another way, Maybe using the tack hammer? Or just a dropdown when looting.

notes.title: 20 December 2023 - Update
notes.notes:
Amended the block planting mode, You now have the option to adjust the material that appears. For example there are a dozen or so different wood patterns to choose from.  This greatly improves the visual's on your base building.

Tack Hammer has been added, This tool will left click to repair blocks and right click to upgrade them. Again you can choose the material appearance of the blocks.  The Upgrade path is Wood, Stone, Iron, Steel, Polished Steel and Plate Steel.   Upgrading a block costs 50% of what the block would be planting a new one.  The tack hammer can be built with a few pieces of iron strip and wood, Its not much use as a weapon.

Adjusted the food and water graphs, Going over 100% now shows a reverse direction green bar, This improves the visual of your food and water bars.  The main character stats page has been updated as the %ages were shown incorrectly.

You should review your Key configuration for the Shape, rotation and materials selectors as they have recently had defaults added and may be set as undefined.

notes.title: 16th December 2023 - Game Mode Update.
notes.notes:
Launching 2 new game modes, Desolation and Desolation Horde.

In the free Desolation game mode, you are cast into a barren world devoid of any structures or non-player characters (NPCs). This survival-driven variant demands meticulous resource management to stay alive. Carefully managing your health and crafting abilities as they become paramount to your survival. 

Desolation Horde is a paid DLC expansion that enhances the Desolation mode by introducing an ever increasing horde of enemies every 15 minutes, adding an element of constant danger and challenge.

These 2 new game modes are considered allot harder than the main game, To that end some rules have changed just for these 2 modes.

All plants can be gathered in the wild.
XP increases at a faster rate.
Resources gather at a faster rate.
Horde AI are significantly more aggressive.
Skill point costs are half of what they are in the main game.
Some skills have been removed as they don't apply ( looting ).
You can craft your own enchantments.

DLC's are NOT required, to complete the desolation achievements.

Bug Fixed and Updates as part of this patch:-

Bolt gun required 21 pieces of ammo to fire, this has been fixed.
Multiplayer AI targeting has been updated.
Issue with cauldron not showing correct potions first time opening.
Leather/animal hide stacking has been increased.
Chicken coop has been slowed down in its processing.
Some screen adjustments on build requirements.

As usual, Any issues please let me know.

notes.title: Update 12th December 2023
notes.notes:
Due to a critical bug with levelling the cauldron to max I have released a patch, This patch contains some things that were not going to be released until the next game mode, So any issues please advise.

Rebalancing + features:-

Advanced arrows are amended so that they are made in batches of 10 using less precious resources.
Sound range increased by 50%.
You can now repair devices and storage containers as well as just blocks. The cost scales depending on damage.
You can put your enchantment and weapons in either slot when enchanting on a cauldron.
Skull spawning rates increased, They were too easy.
Loot abundance reduced, there was far too much
Weapon and clothing properties are now shown on the popup before you make the item Giving you a better idea on comparisons.

BugFixes for all game modes:-

Sometimes crossing between worlds would some slight map corruption, This is now fixed.
Some adventure text not translated, This is fixed.
AI can damage your devices and storage containers.
AI Targeting system adjusted. They switch off path finding to direct approach much easier.
Creature aggro animations were too short, fixed. ( this may go back )
NPC narratives for "Find me an item" have been updated, They were too convoluted before..
Cauldron levelling to 4 literally went nuts, This is fixed.

As usual, Any issues please let me know.

notes.title: 7th Dec 2023 Update ( Ver 3.02 )
notes.notes:
I wasn't planning on releasing this update for a few weeks, however some critical bugs have caused me to launch an intermediate patch.

Game type support on create new game.

Creating initial spawn point will no longer allow you to be over water when using procedural random worlds.

Enchantments can be broken down into enchantment scrolls using the dismantle option on the workbench.

Network protocol change from 3.01 to 3.02 to support the new game types coming soon. This requires maps to be upgraded and all network players to be on the same patch version.

Planting rules for devices have been widened.

Planting your own doors didn't work, this is fixed.

Health bars for carbs, liquids etc now flash when they get too low.
If any of these bars go to zero you will die.

Chicken coop graphics updated.

Energy replenish rates adjusted.

Health replenish rates adjusted.

You are thirsty messages had an incorrect icon.

At some point I broke digging straight down, This has now been fixed.

Walking through doorways adjacent to Iso surfaces could be a collision issue, This has been adjusted.

Composter can now use meat instead of the rotten foods.

Crash on using the Kiosk when set to Ukrainian language has now been fixed.

Sometimes you were unable to pickup a device you planted. This
is now fixed.

Compass bar showing other players has been adjusted.

Issue with the spawn in particles not working when above a certain Z coordinate.

notes.title: 30th November 2023 - update
notes.notes:
In this update:-

Footsteps have been added, a few people have requested this.
Stretch Achievements requiring players to visit and discover areas they may not have previously known existed.

Going forwards:-

This is hopefully the last patch for a little bit as I plan to switch to developing the Next major version change, The Major release is either going to be over Christmas or just after.   I Intend on keeping compatibility with currently played maps, However at worst users will be able to switch to previous versions or the game to open older maps.

notes.title: 26th November 2023 Update ( ver TU )
notes.notes:
Several things in this update, Some have been in the works for a bit.

Changed the NPC hail messages, they were too long winded and stupidly written, Simplified.

Change the NPC infestation messages, same as above.

Final version of the loot container purge and management system,  Any container you plant will never be purged, Any container you move something into will never be purged,  Otherwise they will refresh 3 days after initial opening.

Thirsty and Hungary also now appear on the left side log as well as the audio ques.

Tutorial at the start of the game to introduce you to the basic game mechanics, after 10 minutes of play it will disappear of its own accord ( so players in the middle of an existing map wont see it ).
The task list returns once the tutorial has either been complete or expired.

Holding shift while doing nothing no longer drains energy.

Ladders are tweaked, however may need a touch more work, on list to review next week.

Option added to the game configuration to allow for revered audio.

Network issue regarding players not visible when more than 2 players has been addressed.

As usual, Any feedback is welcome.

notes.title: 23 Nov 2023 - Update
notes.notes:
I want expecting to update this until the weekend, However a critical issue on inventory management has caused me to release early.

Schematics no longer spawn on the moon base, you must travel to the moon mine system to get them.

Goblin helmet/mask now degrades when worn, It will break after about 12 minutes.  Once you have done the mission to acquire it the trader will sell you replacements.

Chicken coop no longer uses seeds when empty.

Actors purge amended for dormant mode actors.

Inventory purge process amended / Several bugs that had the chance of unforeseen consequences have been fixed.

notes.title: 21st November 2023 - small update.
notes.notes:
Fix to the chicken coop to stop items shifted in DE spawning.
Increased the games inventory capacity.  This is temporary quick fix for any users that are reaching any game upper limits.

Intended changes for this next weekend, Fair warning:-

Change the goblin helmet to degrade over time and eventually break, requiring replacements, this is to stop the player being too safe for too long. You will be able to acquire replacements.
Schematics are no longer going to spawn in the moon base and will require the player to travel to the moon mine system to find them.
